description: Opens one place of the app in full: what it is for, what the owner does there, its tabs or the sections of its page with what each holds, and the sections of each tab, each by its path. Analytics comes with what is counted and, for what is not, why and the owner's one step, and the business's own channel and code project with their numbers; Settings with each account's state and its profile as the platform shows it (name, bio and link, read now or within the day, with when; where a platform gives no bio or the read failed, it says so and why: then what the profile says is not known); Sell with every ad grouped by where it sends people (the business's website, each funnel's page, the other pages Marsell made, boosted posts, forms on ads), each group with what runs, what it spent and brought this month and what counts it. Open the place before describing it or naming where on it something is. One agent is agent_open, the cards waiting waiting_read.

place.description: the place, by its name in lower case

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
